gates.title: Provenance and local build
gates.pass_criteria: All source/tool/dependency pins resolved; external drive and floors verified; offline clean bootstrap reproduces tool identities; exact musl/Verus strategy admitted.
gates.negative_controls: Detach/mismatch external volume, move a cache to the system disk, change tool digest, run offline with missing artifact. Preflight refuses before allocating heavy jobs.
gates.receipt_material: Tool lock, storage attestation, source/Compose closure, fresh offline and negative logs.

gates.title: Language freeze and grammar
gates.pass_criteria: Normative EBNF, lexer, semantics, example inputs, spans, ambiguity rules and /1 capability registry agree. EBNF positive/negative corpus and wholly independent parser tests; exact @name := spelling.
gates.negative_controls: Retired assignment, invalid UTF-8, mixed EOL/heredoc delimiter, truncated input, reserved handle, huge limb, overlapping text ambiguity and parser-depth attacks.
gates.receipt_material: Grammar and lexer identities, full golden tokens/AST/diagnostics with byte spans, rejected mutants.

gates.title: Lean byte and surface calculus
gates.pass_criteria: Clean Lean build, L01–L07 across enabled profile; independent surface denotation, lexer/resolution assumptions, sound lowering including refusal, batch normalization and exact original-source keep. Audit every public theorem and run executable oracle.
gates.negative_controls: Move after to start; sequentially read a modified capture; clamp invalid bound; drop a missing optional group; normalize CRLF; remove overlap refusal. Each compiles as a mutant where applicable and fails intended theorem or calibrated oracle.
gates.receipt_material: Clean Lake logs, source/tool identity, symbol and permitted axiom inventory, mutation reports, oracle artifact.

gates.title: Lean authority and preparation
gates.pass_criteria: L08–L09, typed namespace/generation separation, stable inputs, preparation nonmutation, guarded lifecycle semantics, no authority gain by receipt/citation. Enumerate trusted crypto/OS/origin assumptions.
gates.negative_controls: Collide read and edit kinds, reuse alias from another run, omit prepared input field, accept stale or unsupported profile. One legitimate derivation per safety family.
gates.receipt_material: Theorem inventory, traces of pass/refusal/nonvacuity, axiom audit, reviewed assumptions.

gates.title: Frontend, profile and nominal APIs
gates.pass_criteria: Raw input→checked AST→resolved IR works through CLI/library. Strict UTF-8, raw bytes, groups, scopes, paths and budgets; reproducible canonical vectors. Compile-fail tests for checked types.
gates.negative_controls: Unknown/duplicate keys, offset type swap, wrong image, overflow, trace truncation, regex engine exhaustion, aliased same text in other scope.
gates.receipt_material: Compiled fixture logs, public-path output, AST-to-source map, per-phase max/budget counters.

gates.title: Shipping Rust refinement
gates.pass_criteria: Verus verifies actual selected production bodies and checked conversions/unaltered outside bytes for normalized batch. Audit bridges from proof definitions to exact shipping configuration. Differential compare Lean and Rust on success/refusal including input bytes, normalized IR, complete after-image and origins.
gates.negative_controls: Wrong coordinate order, unchecked length add, accidental Unicode normalization, sequential swap, deletion of one source linkage, zero-length boundary bug.
gates.receipt_material: Verus logs and selected function mapping, trusted-base inventory, independent Lean↔Rust vectors, mutation results.

gates.title: Structural quality and bounded execution
gates.pass_criteria: Enforce engineering.md budgets, dependencies, lints, nominal types, module ownership, regex resource profile, no hidden writes. Fuzz lexer/wire/normalizer and adversarial large batches in a controlled environment; measure memory and total work at and above limits.
gates.negative_controls: Oversize module/macro, forbidden dependency/re-export, macro panic, wrong type deserialized, quadratic repeated visits, large output via repeated keep.
gates.receipt_material: AST/graph/lint and compile-fail receipts, memory/time ceilings, fuzz seeds/crashes, reviewed narrowly scoped exceptions.

gates.title: Operational model and inductive proofs
gates.pass_criteria: Extended TLA+ model, TLC finite fault schedules and TLAPS inductive safety plus implementation-action bridge; the supplied seed alone cannot pass. Separate safety/liveness and fairness assumptions.
gates.negative_controls: Blind retry Unknown; grant checked only in prepare; stale generation writes; duplicate key with changed intent; log-confirm before file observation. Retain actual counterexample trace for every named invariant.
gates.receipt_material: TLC config/versions/configuration coverage/deadlock policy, TLAPS proofs/backends, transition-to-code map, mutants.

gates.title: Owner service and authority
gates.pass_criteria: Owner-published pinned schema and vectors. Real initialized stdio, verified grant/scope and dirty-worktree snapshot; replay/validate exact recipe for attributed receipts. Real plan/run/Worktrunk binding. Report actual existing owner gate prerequisites and blockers.
gates.negative_controls: Cross-realm/cross-client handles, forged recipe-to-IR, mocked grant, read-only capture as write target, wrong repo, expired prepare/owner and unsupported capability.
gates.receipt_material: Actual installable artifacts and owner receipts, handshake transcripts sanitized for secrets, valid and denied runs.

gates.title: Native WSL file effects
gates.pass_criteria: Actual descriptor-contained read/compare/install, mode-safe replacement, correct temp/rename/fsync lifecycle, fresh handle/receipt and no-change/no-write result. Verify effective reservation and quiescence under the declared writer model.
gates.negative_controls: Symlink race, hard link, special file, stale digest with unchanged excerpt, path escape, old FD, ENOSPC/short write, read-only parent, formatter drift, unsafe metadata profile.
gates.receipt_material: Real WSL filesystem and Worktrunk evidence, before/after bytes/metadata and syscall fault evidence.

gates.title: Crash, retry and Run Watch
gates.pass_criteria: Kill actual adapter/host at each durable boundary, restart and reconcile under same EffectId or block. Acks and TUI bind to exact outcome and head; selection/rendering has zero effect. Different sessions reuse only verified durable bindings.
gates.negative_controls: Lost response, two concurrent applies with same key, reused key with changed intent, altered host generation, crash after rename/before dir sync, lagged activity projection, stale receipt.
gates.receipt_material: Fault matrix, event/ref counts, zero second logical dispatch, retained unknown paths, independently observed content.

gates.title: File lifecycle and multi-repository visibility
gates.pass_criteria: Open real absent/existing cases for create/remove/rename with explicit path and freshness guards. Multi-file/repo recipes orchestrated as distinct effects, report exact applied prefix. Demonstrate one failed file does not turn run green.
gates.negative_controls: Create races with another create; rename target appears, cross-device rename, stale removal, ACL/linked file, denied repo B after A succeeded, unknown first effect on replay.
gates.receipt_material: Native outcomes, partial/failure receipts and TUI snapshots, authority and retention checks.

gates.title: Whole-language conformance and agent usability
gates.pass_criteria: Freeze complete task corpus and labels before trial. Compare agent's current editor/patch tooling against Splicery on matched held-out tasks. Every normative syntax form exercised from raw recipe to actual observed file or documented refusal. Include all 5 anchor tasks, multiple file formats and a genuine binary fixture.
gates.negative_controls: Seed duplicate regions, stale formatter edit, Unicode/CRLF/no final LF, tempting regeneration of comments, misordered marker pair, hidden unrelated file. Hidden checks must detect a corrupted candidate.
gates.receipt_material: Exact task/seed/model/harness/token meter, successful completions, wrong-target rate, retries, bytes resent, input/output tokens, time and correction logs.

gates.title: Artifact, runtime and offline reproduction
gates.pass_criteria: Static Linux x86_64 musl client, exact pinned compatible adapter, SBOM/licenses, reproducible source inputs, deterministic outputs or explained differences, cold offline rebuild, clean runtime smoke without build tools.
gates.negative_controls: Invoke with missing/degraded host, incompatible protocol, stale cached artifact, compromised tool lock, missing external storage or proof tools on runtime PATH. No fallback to shell writer.
gates.receipt_material: Binary and image hashes, ELF/runtime inspection, install smoke, SBOM, cold build and disclosure of any reproducibility variance.

gates.title: Independent release decision
gates.pass_criteria: Every mandatory gate at matching /1 scope passed against the release closure. Independent reviewer traces a recipe to actual retained bytes, theorem and receipt. All failing/blocked paths and counterexamples have a disposition.
gates.negative_controls: Remove/alter a predecessor receipt, change crate feature/fixture/profile, replace test binary with mock, mark skipped gate pass. Aggregate must refuse.
gates.receipt_material: Signed/admitted release decision as applicable, immutable evidence index and compatibility/limits note.
